- **Chrome Web Store upload file.** Releases now include
  `skipper-chrome-web-store-<version>.zip`, the extension without the fixed id
  that the store rejects. Keep using `relay-extension-<version>.zip` if you
  load the extension unpacked.
- Coming from 0.2.x? Read the 0.3.0 notes first: both Android apps have new
  package ids and must be reinstalled and paired again.
